description: Corrected null-distribution figure for the canonical P1 loop test
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d=pd.read_csv('work/p1_loop_null_distribution.csv')
null=d[d.source=='null_noninhibitor'].rmsd.values
pi15=d[d.source=='PI15_mature'].rmsd.values
cap=d[d.source=='CAP_paralogs'].rmsd.values
p=np.mean(null<=pi15.min())
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.8,4.6))
ax.hist(null,bins=35,color='#c8c8c8',edgecolor='w',label=f'Arg/Lys sites in 13 non-inhibitor proteins (n={len(null)})')
ax.axvspan(0.55,0.64,color='#2ca02c',alpha=.4,label='true canonical P1 sites, held-out fit (0.57-0.62 A)')
ax.axvline(pi15.min(),color='#d62728',lw=2.5,label=f'best PI15 site: Arg131, {pi15.min():.2f} A')
ax.axvline(cap.min(),color='#1f77b4',lw=2,ls='--',label=f'best CAP-paralog site (CRISP3/GLIPR1/PI16): {cap.min():.2f} A')
ax.set_xlabel("backbone RMSD of a P3-P3' segment to canonical inhibitor reactive-site loops (A)")
ax.set_ylabel('number of Arg/Lys sites')
ax.set_title('PI15 has no reactive-site loop.\n'
             f'0 of {len(null)} random Arg/Lys sites reach the canonical range, so the test is diagnostic;\n'
             f'the best PI15 arginine is an ordinary turn that {100*p:.0f}% of random sites match '
             f'(0.5 such sites expected among the 16 in PI15).',fontsize=10,loc='left')
ax.legend(fontsize=8); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print('corrected figure values: p=%.3f, expected hits=%.1f, null n=%d, true-P1 max=%.2f'%(p,16*p,len(null),0.62))
